crew.overview: In 1868, after the Bakumatsu war ends, the ex-assassin Kenshin Himura traverses Japan with an inverted sword, to defend the needy without killing.
crew.title: Rurouni Kenshin Part I: Origins

crew.original_title: バイオハザード ダムネーション
crew.overview: U.S. federal agent Leon S. Kennedy sneaks into the "East Slavic Republic" to verify rumors that Bio-Organic Weapons (BOWs) are being used in the country's civil war, which the U.S. and Russia are making preparations to jointly intervene in. Right after his infiltration, the U.S. government orders him to leave immediately. Determined to uncover the truth, Leon ignores the order and enters the battlefield to end the chain of tragedies caused by the BOWs.
crew.title: Resident Evil: Damnation

crew.overview: Nathan Algren is an American hired to instruct the Japanese army in the ways of modern warfare, which finds him learning to respect the samurai and the honorable principles that rule them. Pressed to destroy the samurai's way of life in the name of modernization and open trade, Algren decides to become an ultimate warrior himself and to fight for their right to exist.
crew.title: The Last Samurai

details.biography:
Kenji Sato is known for numerous works as both a stuntman and an action instructor.

He won the Japan Action Award for Best Stuntmann in 2015.

Major film credits include

Rurouni Kenshin, Marco Polo, 47 Ronin, The Wolverine, Special ID, The Pacific, Resident Evil IV, V, The Final Chapter, The Last Samurai, etc…
details.name: Kenji Sato
